name: 30620 · Bethlehem, GA
findings: ZIP 30620 (Bethlehem) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (67%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30620 (Bethlehem) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 30620 (Bethlehem) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 30620 (Bethlehem) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
